text.en: Pet parents praise business owner Jeanetta and her team of walkers and sitters for exceptional professionalism and dependability. Reviewers frequently mention staff members by name, expressing deep appreciation for their punctuality, flexibility with last-minute schedule changes, and consistent commitment to high standards of pet care.

Clients emphasize how thoughtfully the sitters accommodate pets with challenging temperaments, including dogs with severe separation anxiety, leash reactivity, or caution around new people. Multiple reviews share that dogs return from walks exhausted and happy, showing complete comfort and affection toward their designated caregivers.

Pet owners consistently appreciate the thorough communication provided during walks and overnight stays. Reviewers highlight daily visit notes, abundant photo updates, and an easy-to-use client app that keeps families informed about their pets' activities, offering peace of mind while owners are away at work or traveling.

q.en: What services do clients frequently use?

a.en: Reviewers report using daily dog walks, pack hikes, in-home overnight sitting, and private boarding stays.

q.en: How do sitters keep owners informed?

a.en: Walkers provide detailed journal entries and frequent photo updates through an accessible client portal.

q.en: Can the team handle anxious or reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients specifically praise the staff for successfully managing reactive dogs and pets with separation anxiety.
Yes, pet parents appreciate the team's flexibility when unexpected scheduling changes or urgent walks arise.
